{{Quote|The news media isn't permitted to&mdash;''"<br />"''What are you going to do, Lieutenant? Blast them on a live holofeed?|Rasher Ke'e and Jaina Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Rasher Ke'e''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in [[Galactic Alliance Security]], serving at a secret [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] where [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] were being held in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and media representatives arrived with a document giving them permission to visit the Horns. Ke'e was instructed by Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] to allow only the Jedi access to the Horns, but the Jedi neglected her instructions, ensuring that the press accessed the Horns as well.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Horns and the Jedi can follow, Rasher. No one else.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|Atar and Rasher Ke'e|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Rasher Ke'e was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Abyss" /> By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third instalment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> she had attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], and was stationed at a secret [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Abyss" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] began to develop a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] which caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors.<ref name="Abyss" /> The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to deal with the matter by [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encasing]] the afflicted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> Two of these Jedi, [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]] and [[Valin Horn]], were placed in the blockhouse in which Ke'e was stationed.<ref name="Abyss" />

[[File:JainaSolo_EssentialAtlas.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Rasher Ke'e pursued Jaina Solo (pictured) on Coruscant.]]
Around this time a group of Jedi, led by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], acquired a legal document from [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]] granting them visitation rights to the Horns. They arrived at the blockhouse with the Horns' [[Parent/Legends|parents]] and a large contingent of press. Solo presented the document to Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]], who was forced to lead them to a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] that would take them to the carbonite-encased Jedi. Ke'e stood outside the turbolift, and Atar ordered that she allow only the Jedi and the Horns' parents through; as well as to check them all for [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. Ke'e attempted to carry out her orders, instructing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] to wait so that she could be searched, but Cilghal disregarded her request to search her for weapons, claiming she had not brought any. Frustrated, Ke'e ordered the rest of the present Security [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to secure the lobby. She then tried to prevent the press from entering the turbolift, but Solo questioned the lieutenant's ability to stop them and led the reporters into the turbolift. Ke'e then threatened Solo, who disregarded the comment and followed the rest of the Jedi and reporters to the Horns.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You are going to regret that, Jedi. We have a long reach.''"<br />"''Lieutenant Ke'e, I have been threatened by assassin droids, Yuuzhan Vong Warmasters, and Sith Lords. ''Them'', I worried about.|Rasher Ke'e and Jaina Solo, after Solo ignored Ke'e's orders to prevent the press from visiting the Horns|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Rasher Ke'e attempted to follow her orders to the best of her ability and became very frustrated when the Jedi ignored her instructions. Ke'e even went so far as to threaten Solo, who disregarded the threat as unalarming.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Equipment==
Ke'e wore [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that was ornamented with a lieutenant's patch on its collar and her name above a pocket.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rasher Ke'e appeared in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2009]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Abyss" />
